# AI Concept Explorer

Build an interactive learning page that explains common AI categories.

## Required behavior
- [ ] Topic cards with plain-language definitions
- [ ] Examples classified by approach
- [ ] A classification quiz and glossary

Use synthetic or properly licensed data. Do not commit credentials or personal data. Document setup, evaluation, limitations, and reset instructions.

"""Starter scaffold for AI Concept Explorer.

Implement one milestone at a time and keep evaluation separate from development.
"""

def main():
    print("Project: AI Concept Explorer")
    print("Next step: define inputs, outputs, baseline, and evaluation criteria.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
